Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://ukscb.bank.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 17-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Uttarakhand State Co-operative Bank (UKSCB). It is a prominent state-level cooperative bank in Uttarakhand, offering various banking services and employment opportunities in the region.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for which applications are invited?
faq.answer: Applications are invited for the post of Cooperative Intern. This role is designed for individuals interested in gaining experience within the cooperative banking sector and contributing to its operations.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available in this UKSCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Cooperative Intern posts. These positions are distributed across different District Cooperative Banks within Uttarakhand, offering opportunities in specific locations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Cooperative Intern posts is Offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it by post to the specified address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the completed application form for the Cooperative Intern posts is 17 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute delays.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications required for the Cooperative Intern post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an MBA or equivalent in Marketing Management / Cooperative Management / Agri Business Management / Rural Development Management, or a Bachelor's degree or Post Graduate Diploma in Agriculture/Cooperation or allied sector. Proficiency in computer skills is also essential.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applying to the Cooperative Intern position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Cooperative Intern post is a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 30 years. Candidates must ensure they fall within this age bracket as of the specified cut-off date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Cooperative Intern post?
faq.answer: The selected Cooperative Intern will receive a salary of Rs. 25000 per month. This stipend is offered for the duration of the contractual engagement, providing a stable income during the internship period.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for UKSCB Cooperative Intern Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the UKSCB Cooperative Intern Recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any charges, making it accessible to all eligible applicants.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Uttarakhand State Co-operative Bank, which is https://ukscb.bank.in/. It is crucial to refer to the official website for all updates and detailed instructions.
